task.description: WF-03 Step 4 -- write the ISS-0765 regression test to design section 7's eleven-row matrix, measure it red against the pre-fix code, apply and measure the two design-specified mutants M-1a/M-1b for the type-only .members retype, revert and verify, and correct two wording slips REVIEWER found in the design header.
acceptance_criteria: web/src/api/__tests__/identity.groupsApi.test.ts implements the eleven-row matrix exactly as section 7/7.1 specify after the rework-1 fold
the literal raw-fetch token never appears in the new file; no forbidlist entry weakened, no allowedPaths entry added
row 10 is scoped to groupsApi's own captured URLs, not a whole-file absence assertion
rows 1-6, 7(i), 8, 9, 10 measured RED against the pre-fix tree; 7(ii) and 11 green pre-fix by design
M-1a and M-1b applied and measured, with whatever tsc actually emitted recorded verbatim
mutants reverted and the revert verified
npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm test, npm run guards green with real quoted output
committed and pushed to origin/feature/WF03-ISS0765-20260924 with no divergence

scope_test.reasoning: Step 3's artifacts_out are three application-logic TypeScript files under web/src/ (api client, types, a React page). Not docs-only, not build-config. A runtime regression test against the corrected URL literals and request bodies is meaningful, and was written.

test_file.why_16_not_11: Row 10 is an it.each over the six surviving groupsApi functions, so it expands to six vitest cases. 10 other rows contribute one case each. Row 7 is a single it block carrying both halves, per the rework-1 fold that merged old rows 7 and 8.
test_file.harness: Mirrors web/src/api/__tests__/identity.removeMembers.test.ts: // @vitest-environment jsdom, a window.fetch double ASSIGNED from vi.fn(), setToken/clearToken in beforeEach/afterEach, assertions on the exact method + path actually requested. No wall-clock dependency, no unseeded randomness -- every response body is a fixed literal the test constructs.
test_file.guard_constraint_honoured: The literal eight-character token matched by forbidlist.ts:40-44's raw-fetch-outside-client pattern appears NOWHERE in the file, comments included -- verified by grep (exit 1, no match) before the guards run, and confirmed green by npm run guards. No forbidlist entry was weakened, removed or allowedPaths-exempted (design INV-F). The file also contains no '#' character at all, so the literal-colour pattern cannot fire on it.
test_file.row_10_scoping: Row 10 asserts over groupsApi's OWN captured URLs via it.each, NOT over file content. A whole-file absence assertion would fail for the wrong reason: /api/v1/admin/ still legitimately appears at identity.ts:73-88 in rolesApi, which is ISS-0812's scope. This is the correctness note REVIEWER carried into Step 4, and it is honoured.

mutants.why_mutants_are_required: Decision (b)'s .members retype is a TYPE-ONLY change. web/src/api/client.ts:158-169's request<T> ends in `return response.json() as Promise<T>` and T is erased at runtime, so client.get<User[]> and client.get<GroupMemberPage> are byte-identical against the same spy body. No runtime row can carry fail-first evidence for it. Both mutants were specified by the design (section 7.1), not improvised here.
mutants.applied_where: The same throwaway worktree, re-detached at bcddcebf (the post-fix tree the mutants assume). Baseline in that worktree before any mutant: npx tsc -b tsconfig.json --force exit 0, and the new test file 16 passed (16).

M-1a.definition: Keep design section 3.1's GroupMember/GroupMemberPage and the retyped groupsApi.members; revert ONLY section 3.2's six GroupsPage.tsx edits to their pre-fix text. Decision (c)'s addMember caller rename at :76 was deliberately KEPT, since it belongs to section 4, not 3.2. Verified by `git diff main` on the mutated file, which showed only the addMember rename plus one cosmetic blank line as the residual difference from pre-fix.

probe_npm_test.interpretation: GREEN IS THE POINT, not a failure. The runtime suite is blind to the retype while type-check is not -- which is exactly why decision (b) chose the retype over an unwrap: it makes tsc the mechanical detector for a missed .members consumer, the highest-risk item in this fix.

caveat_N1_outcome.design_prediction: tsc errors at the reverted :103, :223, :227, :228 sites -- explicitly flagged by the design gate as a FLOOR, not an exact expectation.
caveat_N1_outcome.what_actually_happened: Diagnostics landed at :104, :224 and :228 -- the design's :103/:223/:227 shifted by one line because the mutant removes the useMemo binding. There is NO diagnostic for the design's :228 reasoning (user.user_id not existing on GroupMember), because that line sits inside the callback of the .map at the line above that just failed to resolve; the diagnostic surfaces instead as TS7006 implicit-any on the callback parameter at (228,41). This is precisely the characteristic CAVEAT N-1 predicted.
caveat_N1_outcome.action_taken: NONE. The mutant was NOT adjusted to manufacture a :228 diagnostic. Four distinct source positions and five diagnostics clear the floor, and whatever tsc actually emitted is what is recorded -- here and in test/specs/ISS-0765.md.

M-1b.unplanned_observation: M-1b's first three diagnostics land in the NEW TEST FILE ITSELF, at row 7(ii)'s result.items / result.count / result.next_cursor assertions. Row 7(ii) therefore does carry decision (b) -- not as a runtime red row, which section 7.1 correctly says is impossible, but as a COMPILE-TIME guard: if groupsApi.members's declared return type ever stops being the real envelope, the test file stops type-checking. Reported as an observation neither the design nor the gate anticipated. It is NOT claimed as fail-first evidence and does not change row 7(ii)'s recorded classification.

design_doc_corrections.authorised_by: ORCH, on REVIEWER's step-03d observations O-1 and O-2. Wording only -- no normative content changed.

O-1.before: | `web/src/types/api.ts` | three new exported interfaces, additive only |
O-1.after: | `web/src/types/api.ts` | four new exported interfaces, additive only |
O-1.why: The body specifies four: GroupMember and GroupMemberPage (section 3.1), GroupListResponse (section 5), GroupMemberAddResult (section 6). Four were implemented. The header undercounted.

O-2.why: Section 3.2's own table has six substantive rows (line 108 is listed as textually unchanged and is not one of them). Six plus section 4's one caller edit is the seven that were implemented.

design_doc_corrections.residual_not_changed: Section 6 still introduces GroupMemberAddResult as 'Third new interface ... beside the other two', which reads oddly now that the header says four. It is loose prose rather than a count mismatch -- a reader following the enumeration (3.1 gives two, section 5 one, section 6 one) still arrives at four -- and REVIEWER did not flag it, so it was left alone rather than edited beyond the authorisation. Recorded here so a later audit does not treat it as a new discrepancy.

new_findings.summary: Row 7(ii) is additionally a compile-time guard on groupsApi.members's declared return type, not only the runtime forward-regression guard the design classified it as. Evidence: M-1b's tsc diagnostics at identity.groupsApi.test.ts(212-214). No action needed; recorded because it strengthens AC2's coverage argument beyond what the design claimed.

carried_gaps: NO INTEGRATION EVIDENCE. Every command in this step exercises the code against a vi.fn() double whose Response the test constructs. No HTTP request left the process and no Letflow instance was dialled (FRONTEND-DEV recorded HTTP 000 on a localhost:4000 probe; REVIEWER carried the gap forward). It is unproven BY EXECUTION that the six /api/v1/identity/groups routes return 2xx against a running server with a real :GroupsManage token. Owner: UAT-RUNNER -- list groups, open Manage members, add a member, remove a member, delete an empty group. Step 5 must not close ISS-0765 claiming end-to-end evidence.

The members dialog is still capped at the first page (50 members) and GroupMemberPage.next_cursor is returned but unread -- design section 3.3 / OQ-2. Pre-existing, made reachable by this fix, deliberately untested here.
result.next_action: ORCH: route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 4b).
